[b]ERENE WORLD CUP 2028 MATCHDAY 6 GROUP STAGES![/b]

[Spoiler=Neue Republik vs Rosenmarkke]Neue Republik turned the pitch into a storm of attacking intent, overwhelming Rosenmarkke in a ruthless 4-0 display that barely gave their opponents room to breathe. From the opening whistle, Neue pressed high and moved the ball with sharp, vertical purpose, breaking through early when Neue striker struck in the 13th minute with a composed finish. Rosenmarkke tried to respond in kind, but their open style only left more space behind, and Neue punished it again as Neue striker doubled the lead in the 58th minute with a second goal on his day. As the match sretched, Neue's dominance only grew stronger, waves of attacks crashing forward while rosenmarkke struggled to recover. The third goal arrived late, with Neue's winger finding the net in the 86th minute to seal the result, before Neue defender added a final blow deep into stoppage time by a header, putting an emphatic stamp on the performance. A game expected to be a back-and-forth attacking clash for Rosenmarkke on their pas perfomance instead became a one-sided showcase.

Neue Republik 4 - 0 Rosenmarkke
Player 9 13',58'
Player 7 86'
Player 4 90+1'

Match summary: https://ibb.co/PGqznM7j
[/spoiler]

[Spoiler=Vespurias vs Daesun]Vespurias and Daesun played out a tightly wound 0-0 draw, a match where ambition kept colliding with discipline until neither could break through. Vespurias carried the attacking momentum for most of the game, pushing forward with fluid combinations and testing the edges of the box, but Daesun stood like a wall, compact, organized and patient. Every forward surge from Vespurias seemed to meet a perfectly timed interception or last-ditch clearance, while Daesun sometimes ventured forward, choosing to absorb pressure and strike on occasional counters. As the minutes ticked by, frustration crept into Vespurias' play, their chances growing more desperate than dangerous, while Daesun's defensive resolve only hardened. Even in closing stages, when Vespurias threw numbers forward in search of a winner, Daesun held their shape with unwavering focus. In the end, it finished 0-0, a match defined by persistence versus resistance.

Vespurias 0 - 0 Daesun

Match summary: https://ibb.co/67GgVHmX
[/spoiler]

[Spoiler=Wuloosya vs Maqamistan]Wuloosya pulled off a classic smash-and-grab victory against Maqamistan, edging the contest 1-0 in a match that flipped expectations on their head. Maqamistan came in attacking intent and stayed true to it, dominating possession and pushing forward in waves, their forwards constantly testing the defensive line. But Wuloosya remained compact and disciplined, absorbing pressure with remarkable organization, turning the game into a test of patience for their opponents. Despite Maqamistan's creativity and sustained pressure, clear chances were hard to come by, with Wuloosya's defense cutting off angles and forcing efforts from distance. Then, against the run of play, the breakthrough arrived in the 72nd minute, Wuloosya's striker Vanbrook capitalized on a rare opportunity, finishing clinically to stun the match. From there, Wuloosya doubled down their defensive shape, closing spaces and frustrating Maqamistan even further. The final whistle confirmed a 1-0 win, a triumph of resilience and efficiency over attacking dominance.

Wuloosya 1 - 0 Maqamistan
E. Vanbrook 72'

Match summary: https://ibb.co/jZ3nmL4b
[/spoiler]

[Spoiler=Bascover vs Tianyou Dynasty]A tense stalemate unfolded between Bascover and Tianyou, the kind of match that felt like a chessboard disguised as a football pitch. Bascover controlled long stretches of possession, patiently circulating the ball and probing for openings, but Tianyou's defensive shape held firm, disciplined and hard to break. Chances came in counter attacks rather than possession play, Bascover rattled he crossbar midway through the first half, while Tianyou nearly stole the lead on a swift counter attack that forced a sharp and amazing save from the Bascoveran keeper, Christopher Chueden. As the match wore on, the temp dipped into a tactical battle, with both sides wary of making the mistake that could decide it. Despite late pressure and a few nervy moments in stoppage time, neither steam could find the breakhtrough, and the contest ended 0-0, frustrating for the attackers, but a display of structure and resilience from both sides' defense.

Bascover 0 - 0 Tianyou Dynasty

Match summary: https://ibb.co/QFQ1D5cy
[/spoiler]
